rule: Bare names resolve through local bindings, the module, import lists (with `T (..)` fields and hiding), unqualified imports of scanned modules (following `module M` re-exports and export lists), the Prelude (`Prelude.show`, medium) and the one unlisted external import; qualified imports `Map.size` medium. **C4 Unresolved references are preserved.** A call the tool cannot resolve is still emitted as a low guess (`recv.m`, `.m`, a bare name). It is never dropped and never promoted to a resolved ID. Silence in the graph means no call, or a `coverage` note.
notes: One.hs has exactly one unlisted external import (`Data.Char`), so a bare name not found locally, in the module or the Prelude resolves to it: `Data.Char.toUpper`, medium. In `loud`, `toUpper` is only passed to `map`: no edge. Two.hs has two unlisted external imports, so neither is "the one unlisted external import" and `isDigit` / `fromMaybe` stay unresolved bare names, low (C4: never dropped, never promoted; confidence low: a bare name not found in the scan). `frobnicate` is defined nowhere: low bare name (C4). The fixture does not need to compile.
